1651-1770-3875-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1770-3875-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-1770-3875-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Elesh Norn, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

678-3967-5865.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn
678-3967-5865.description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it triggers, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Flamecache Gecko.
When Flamecache Gecko dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Flamecache Gecko from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

1981-4506-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1981-4506-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2661-4770-8122.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{W} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Because Whitemane Lion will have 5 power due to The Muckslinger Gang, Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand. 
Repeat.

2034-4875-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2034-4875-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

2981-4381-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2981-4381-4694-7306.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 and trample until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

3478-3967-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Dimir Aqueduct.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Dimir Aqueduct from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

1563-2457-7730-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

129-955-1409-3755.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1394-2060-2511-7038-7741.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Shang-Chi.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Shang-Chi.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

470-2034-2661-7635.notablePrerequisites: The total power of creatures you control is at least 10 plus Ghalta's commander tax.
470-2034-2661-7635.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Ghalta from the command zone by paying {G}{G}.
Gwenna and Ascendant Packleader trigger.
Resolve the Gwenna trigger, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ascendant Packleader trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Ghalta. Then, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ghalta.
Choose to return Ghalta to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

3175-4775-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

457-620-3490.description:
Cast Animation Module by paying {1}.
When Animation Module enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate Urza's first ability by tapping an artifact you control, adding {U}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

423-907-1437-3177--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-907-1437-3177--85.description:
Cast Sakura-Tribe Scout by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Sakura-Tribe Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Sakura-Tribe Scout copy.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-6604-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

240-2034-4359-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7234.easyPrerequisites: There are a total of at least two cards in all hands.
6797-6972-7234.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Realm Seekers.
When Realm Seekers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7158.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

3334-4613-4968-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Lae'zel.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

643-3951-5703-6441.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
643-3951-5703-6441.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

539-1376-4657.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
539-1376-4657.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Priest of Titania.
Repeat.

997-2523-5560.notablePrerequisites: Rangers of Ithilien is your Ring-bearer.
997-2523-5560.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Rangers of Ithilien.
When Rangers of Ithilien dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Rangers of Ithilien that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Rangers of Ithilien token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Rangers of Ithilien token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1251-3259-5359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-5359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1491-2445-2464-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2445-2464-6218.notablePrerequisites:
Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-2445-2464-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2816-3156-4763-5004.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Cathodion.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Cathodion, targeting Koll.
When Cathodion dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Cathodion by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

465-803-1753-3742-4251.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-803-1753-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1479-1671-5702.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1671-5702.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Springheart Nantuko, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1418-2788-3634-4872.notablePrerequisites: You haven't cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
1418-2788-3634-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Double Vision triggers, copying Time Warp.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Time Warp to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1789-2232-3558-4875.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Cloudstone Curio triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-1951.notablePrerequisites:
Speaker of the Heavens does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is at least seven greater than your starting life total.
It is your turn.
1636-1951.description:
Activate Speaker of the Heavens by tapping it, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token with flying.
The Angel enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

224-1257-1671.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.
